nom: Peace Out Salicylic Acid Acne Treatment Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin say it absorbs quickly, helps control oil over time, and leaves skin feeling balanced and less greasy rather than shiny.
segments.dry: The few reviewers with dry skin describe it as hydrating rather than drying, making it usable as a nightly spot treatment for breakouts without added dryness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin form the largest group and mostly report no irritation or increased breakouts, appreciating the fragrance-free, silicone-free formula; two dissenting reviewers say fragrance or bergamot oil in the formula bothered their sensitive skin or may worsen breakouts.

concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report visibly reduced breakouts, often within 24 hours to a few days, including for hormonal, cystic and stress-related acne; a minority say it did little for their skin or caused an initial purge before improving, and one fragrance-sensitive reviewer says it may worsen breakouts.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers say it fades red or dark post-acne marks and hyperpigmentation over one to a few weeks, often crediting the niacinamide and vitamin C alongside the salicylic acid; no reviewer reports it worsening discoloration.
concerns.redness: Reviewers frequently describe visible redness around active pimples calming down overnight or within a few days of use.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers with oily skin say it reduces oiliness and shine over time and helps keep pores decongested without feeling greasy.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including some with dry skin, say the serum does not dry out their skin and layers fine under a moisturizer; a few mention mild initial dryness or flakiness during the first days of use.

aspects.libelle: Noticeable herbal scent, disliked by a few
Pump can dispense too much product at once
Layers well under makeup and moisturizer
Received expired stock in at least one order

extraits.texte: I honestly had high hopes for this acne serum but it didn't really do anything for my skin. I don't know if my skin just doesn't like the product but it barely did anything for my pimple. If your skin is sensitive to fragrance, I wouldn't recommend this product as it may aggravate breakouts even more.

extraits.titre: Didn't see much of a difference
extraits.texte: I'm not sure if this product helped my acne overall within a months time, however it didn't give me more breakouts due to my sensitive skin. I thought the serum formula went on well easily and I applied this every night. Didn't see too much results, but it did lighten up the scars left by my old acne a little.

The serum has a gel like texture which I like because my oily skin can absorb very easily. It's nice and smooth and it doesn't feel sticky or heavy. Has a herbal scent from the centella asiatica. That ingredient always worked great on my skin and I know that this serum will do the same, just need time. At first what I noticed was that my skin was a bit tighter but I knew that this is a good sign. It means that my skin isn't too oily and the serum worked. By now, using it for 10 days, I can see that the red spots are lighter and smaller. It helps me with my cystic acne and clogged pores. I'm keep using it.

The Peace Out Acne Serum has been a total game changer in my routine! I get bad hormonal acne + clogged pores that can be difficult to keep under control, but this serum helped clear up my skin so well! A single overnight use showed around 50% improvement in redness and marks, and those blemishes were completely gone after using the serum for 2-3 more days. It's a pretty gentle serum for how strong it is, and it's very hydrating so it's great for dry skin. I highly recommend this product!

I really appreciate this serum's lightweight, soothing, and gentle texture. It also absorbs really quickly and does not leave any residue on my skin after use. My skin is pretty sensitive, so I like that it is both silicone-free and fragrance-free, which really benefits my skin's texture. In addition to bumps in my skin's texture, I have significant scarring and discoloration that this serum has been helping with.

extraits.titre: Great moisturizer without the greasy feel!
extraits.texte: The moisturizer glides on to the skin with ease. I have oily skin, so becoming greasy is a main component I look at when trying out a new products. I was pleased to see the result of moisturized skin without the greasy look or feel! It did not cause any breakouts, but actually helped tame a few of my existing. It also lays great under my foundation. So far, I am really pleased with this product!

The is the only serum that is so effective for my hormonal acne. I use this as a spot treatment when I get big inflamed pimples during that time of the month. So impressed with how quick they shrink and in days they are gone. Love that it works for my very sensitive as well. Must try!
